selection_rule: Select highest 50/50 real/stress chip improvement averaged across two development seeds, among variants with positive improvement when main4 is excluded; if none qualify, choose highest aggregate only as an experimental candidate.
promotion_rule: All unit and official HTTP checks pass, no fallbacks. Across eight fresh seed blocks, the 95% Student-t intervals for balanced real/stress improvement AND the same score excluding main4 must be wholly positive. Real-field and stress-field mean improvements must both be nonnegative; real-field match-point improvement interval must be nonnegative. No opponent may show a clear regression worse than 0.25 bb/duplicate deal (upper 95% bound below -0.25), including held-out opponents. No clearly negative head-to-head against jish_4. Otherwise publish experimental and retain jish_4. No further candidate selection using final results.
